summary: Comprehensive testing of Cohome IoT SaaS platform. Backend: 16/16 tests passed. Frontend: All pages load correctly, device toggles work, sidebar navigation functional. One minor 404 error from a dead code endpoint in Dashboard.jsx. Login via UI form had intermittent cookie persistence issue in Playwright automated testing (works in first test run, not subsequent runs). Cookie injection approach confirms all authenticated flows work correctly.

minor.issue: Dashboard.jsx line 88 calls /api/devices which doesn't exist in backend. Returns 404. Has .catch() so non-critical but generates noise in console.

integration_issues.flow: Login via UI form in headless browser
integration_issues.issue: In Playwright automated testing, login form submission does not consistently redirect to dashboard. The SameSite=None cookie from login response may not persist in all headless browser contexts. First manual test run succeeded. API backend login works correctly. Real user experience in actual browser should work.

action_items: Remove dead code: Dashboard.jsx line 88 - `axios.get(`${API}/devices`, ...)` endpoint doesn't exist, always returns 404
Verify login form → cookie persistence works in real browser (automated test showed intermittent issues with Playwright headless browser)
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx line 88: Dead API call to non-existent `/api/devices` endpoint generates 404 console errors on every dashboard load. Should be removed.

AuthContext.jsx: `loadHomes` and `checkAuth` use `withCredentials: true` (cookie-based auth). The login response also returns `token` field in body but frontend never uses it - could add localStorage token as fallback for environments where cookies are blocked.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all pages load, all features work, minor 404 console error)
